song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: In the Vasura year, in Pauṣa, on the dark tenth — Abhinavagupta composed this hymn —
by which the pervasive, compassionate Lord in a flash stills the people’s desert-heat of becoming.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vasurasapauṣe kṛṣṇadaśamyām abhinavaguptaḥ stavam imam akarot yena vibhuḥ bhavati janasya arusantāpaṃ śamayati jhaṭiti dayāluḥ
notes: follows bhavamaru (desert-heat of becoming) with L0/NOTE-terms against printed bhavati…arusantāpaṃ; SA untouched pending adjudication
vasurasa kept as year-name (cf. Dyczkowski Vasura-saṃvatsara)

verses.craft: Dated-signed-outward: private recognition cools the world; bhavamaru reading per NOTE (SA untouched); yena/heat opens kept; Vasura year-name kept.
verses.rejected: (a) normalizing SA → killed: untouched pending adjudication. (b) resolving yena → killed by UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'yena' refers to devotee or hymn is unresolved.", "Whether 'bhavamarusantāpa' is physical or existential heat is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with karuṇa (compassion) / L2+L3 voice
